contributor.literal: Seismological Facility for the Advancement of Geoscience

abstract: A sparse seismic instrument deployment between Casey and Davis stations in East Antarctica, also extending to the east of Casey.  Co-located with GNSS stations and magnetotelluric recording sites.  The network aims to collect data to inform the Earth response to ice sheet change.
title: CAD Seismic Deployment, Casey-Davis Region, East Antarctica
